entry.title: ServiceNow being an external catalog for SAP Ariba Buying
entry.content:
Hi All!! 

Just wanted to ask if you ever met a scenario where ServiceNow catalog is an external catalog for SAP Ariba Buying?

Few words of explanation. 
A Customer implemented SAP Ariba Buying and now is asking about a scenario of looping in ServiceNow catalog where IT services / items PRs would be created and sent to SAP Ariba to underlay regular Ariba approvals WFs.

In my opinion having Guided Buying as an user front end there is no reason to start the process in ServiceNow - but there is a sine-qua-non condition - ServiceNow has to meet SAP Ariba requirements for being an external catalog.

I am aware of the requirements supplier catalog should meet to be published as an external one but in addition I am struggling with finding a green light / red light answer on if ServiceNow catalog meets this criteria.

I thought someone of you guys met such requirement earlier and knows the yes / no answer 🙂  

Before you ask - yes, I informed a Customer about such eventuality and yes, asked Customer to discuss it with ServiceNow 😉 Just thought our Community is quicker in answering 😉 

Thank you in advance. 
Marcin

entry.title: SES rejected in Ariba -is the supplier notified?
entry.content:
When a service entry sheet is created by the buyer directly in SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing
(and not imported from ERP),

 if the buyer rejects the service entry sheet within Ariba,

does the supplier receive any notification (email or Network alert)? and if no notification is sent to the supplier, does the supplier see the status in SBN or SES status not visible to the supplier at all?

 My current understanding is:

• A buyer‑created service entry sheet is handled as a buyer‑side document.
• If it is rejected during the approval flow in Ariba, the status change is only visible to buyer users.
• Since the service entry sheet was never sent to the supplier on SAP Business Network, there is no automatic supplier notification triggered.

I tested this in a sandbox and observed the same behavior.
Since I couldn’t find official documentation explicitly stating this, I would like to confirm.
Can someone please confirm whether this understanding is correct for an Ariba‑native, buyer‑created service entry sheet scenario?

entry.title: Balancing Service PO's in Ariba to $0.00
entry.content:
We create Service PO's and often we need to close PO's because the services are complete but there are funds remaining on the PO.  We "balance" this by changing the dollar value of the PO to the amount the PO was invoiced. This leaves a $0.00 value remaining and the difference is returned to the contract that was used to create the PO.

This will not work if the version of the contract that was used to create the PO has changed. Ariba only recognizes the current version of the contract which leaves unspent money stuck in PO's.  This impacts the business areas that create the PO's because the funds are required to make other purchases.

Has anyone come across this problem?  Ariba says it is the "expected behavior" and an Enhancement request is required to make any changes to the current expected behavior.

entry.title: Ariba Classic Invoicing
entry.content:
Hello Community,
We are a mid-sized company with a global footprint and have been using Ariba Classic Buying and Invoicing for approximately four years.
On the Buying side, our processes have largely stabilized, and the system is performing as expected. However, we continue to face persistent challenges with Invoicing, particularly given our global operations.
From our perspective:

Many of the ongoing issues, bugs, and functional gaps in Ariba Classic Invoicing remain unresolved.
Recent enhancements and fixes appear to be primarily focused on Ariba Central Invoice Management, with limited improvements for the Classic Invoicing solution.
As a result, unless we consider a significant shift in our invoicing approach or technology, we anticipate continued operational inefficiencies and recurring day-to-day issues.

We have invested considerable effort in raising Service Requests (SRs) and submitting Customer Influence requests, but progress has been limited. Invoicing has remained a consistent pain point since our initial go-live.
Looking for insights from the community:

How are other customers managing or coping with the current limitations of Ariba Classic Invoicing?
Are organizations actively transitioning to newer invoicing solutions, and if so, what has your experience been?
Any practical recommendations or workarounds that have helped improve stability or reduce operational overhead?

Appreciate any guidance or shared experiences

Thanks
Ashish

entry.title: Missing requester email address in purchase order PDF
entry.content:
Problem Description:
Currently, the generated purchase order PDF, which is sent to suppliers, does not include the email address of the requester (requisitioner).

As a result, suppliers do not have a direct contact for operational questions related to the purchase order. This leads to inefficiencies, as inquiries must be routed via indirect channels instead of contacting the responsible requester directly.

Impact:

  • Delays in supplier communication
  • Increased internal workload due to forwarding of inquiries
  • Reduced transparency in communication processes

Proposed Solution:
Include the requester’s email address in the purchase order PDF with a clear label (e.g. “Requester”) to enable direct communication.

Preferred placement (please evaluate):

  • In the field “Deliver to:” (replacing or complementing the current address)
  • And/or in the field “Recipient” as an additional contact detail

entry.title: How can I change the Default Date Created Value in Ariba Search screen
entry.content:
In Ariba Buying and Invoicing, any time anyone searches using the toolbar at the top left of the screen, whether it be Requisitions, Purchase Orders, or Invoices, Ariba defaults the 'Date Created' field to Custom and then has date ranges for the last 2 weeks. We always have to change it to 'No Choice' and then search again.  This is getting missed by a lot of users. 

Is it possible to default this to something else and if so how? 
Ideally we would just like it to be 'No Choice' and just search based on the ID they enter. Otherwise I'd say if that is not possible, is there a way to change the default dates that appear? (i.e. maybe the last year instead of the last 2 weeks)

This is the field to which i'm referring and how we would want it. 

Thanks!
Janel
